lines_pipelines.label: Oil pipelines (flow status)
lines_pipelines.plain: Mapped oil pipelines coloured by the documented status of the oil block they serve; proposed routes are shown but were never built.

points_crisis_sites.label: Protection sites and displacement camps
points_crisis_sites.plain: UN Protection of Civilians sites, camps for displaced people and refugee camps, with changes in status over time (for example PoC sites turned into IDP camps in 2020-21). Not a complete list.

points_fmr_monitoring.label: IOM travel monitoring points
points_fmr_monitoring.plain: Places where IOM staff count people on the move, and the months each was active. Flow-monitoring numbers depend on where these points are.

points_health.label: Health facilities (registry status over time)
points_health.plain: Hospitals and clinics with their registry status in each period, built by comparing the 2016, 2019-20, 2023 and 2024 facility lists and adding documented closures; being listed does not prove a facility was working.

points_insecurity_insight.label: Attacks on aid, health and education
points_insecurity_insight.plain: Reported incidents against aid workers, health care and schools, and conflict-related sexual violence, 2018-2025. Dots sit at state centres, not at the real incident location.

points_logcluster_hubs.label: Aid logistics hubs and warehouses
points_logcluster_hubs.plain: Humanitarian logistics hubs and shared storage sites shown on UN Logistics Cluster maps, 2018-2026. Positions are the town, not the exact warehouse.

points_markets.label: Markets with WFP price monitoring
points_markets.plain: Markets where the World Food Programme records food and fuel prices, and the months each reported. Price layers come from these markets.

points_oil.label: Oil fields and wells (production status)
points_oil.plain: Oil fields and mapped wells coloured by the documented production status of their oil block, including the 2018-19 restarts, the 2024 export halt and the December 2025 Heglig disruption.

points_schools.label: Schools (status over time)
points_schools.plain: Schools with their status from the 2015 and 2019 school lists, the 2019-20 village assessment and the 2020-21 COVID-19 closure; after May 2021 statuses are carried forward because no school-level data exists.

points_ucdp_events.label: Deadly conflict events (UCDP)
points_ucdp_events.plain: Individual violent events that killed at least one person, 2018-2025, from the Uppsala Conflict Data Program, with the estimated number of deaths.

points_unmiss.label: UN peacekeeping bases
points_unmiss.plain: Locations of UN peacekeeping (UNMISS) bases and team sites over time, with approximate troop numbers and base closures.

points_water_points.label: Water points (last known status)
points_water_points.plain: Boreholes, wells and taps recorded in water-point surveys, mostly from before 2018. Their working status is the last one reported and may be out of date.

polygons_ethnic_groups.label: Ethnic group areas and political power (EPR)
polygons_ethnic_groups.plain: Where ten major ethnic groups live and how much national political power each held in each year, as coded by the Ethnic Power Relations dataset to 2023; the 2023 status is shown unchanged for later years.

points_gbv_one_stop_centres.label: GBV one-stop centres
points_gbv_one_stop_centres.plain: Centres offering medical, psychosocial, legal and police help to survivors of sexual and gender-based violence, shown from the first evidence they were operating; no site was confirmed individually after early 2023.

points_oil_pollution.label: Oil spills and pollution reports
points_oil_pollution.plain: Two documented 2019 oil pipeline spills north of Bentiu and two located reports of contaminated water and flooded wells in the Unity oil fields.

points_oil_wells_flooding.label: Flood water around oil wells (radar)
points_oil_wells_flooding.plain: Mapped oil wells where satellite radar saw open flood water around the well in each period; this shows flooding, not contamination, and misses water under vegetation.

points_surface_water_quality.label: River and wetland water colour (satellite)
points_surface_water_quality.plain: Monthly satellite readings of muddiness at eight river and wetland sites compared with the usual level for that month; this tracks sediment and algae, not oil or chemical pollution.

points_disasters.label: Natural disasters (floods, droughts, storms)
points_disasters.plain: Floods, drought alerts and heatwaves reported in 2018-2025, one dot per affected county (or one for the whole country) shown for as long as the event lasted; flood numbers are people affected as counted by the UN, and a dot sits at the county centre, not at the flooded place.
